title: Uniformly graph-equivalent unitary dressing cannot repair the fixed-free-form obstruction

dressing_boundary.reference: A=H_0+1 on K1430's Gaussian/Fock Hilbert space and B_N=g V_N+C_N with fixed g nonzero and C_N restricted to deterministic vacuum and quadratic counterterms
dressing_boundary.admitted_dressing: U_N is unitary, preserves D(A^(1/2)), and both A^(1/2)U_NA^(-1/2) and A^(1/2)U_N^(-1)A^(-1/2) are bounded uniformly in N
dressing_boundary.pullback_argument: A uniform A-form bound for b_N^U(psi,chi)=<U_N psi,B_N U_N chi> pulls back through U_N^(-1) to a uniform A-form bound for b_N, with only the two graph-equivalence constants changed
dressing_boundary.contradiction: K1439's vacuum-to-four-particle dual norm grows at least as N^2 in norm, so the pulled-back uniform form bound is impossible
dressing_boundary.conclusion: No cutoff-dependent unitary dressing uniformly equivalent to the free form graph repairs the fixed-domain obstruction
dressing_boundary.ceiling: Singular dressings whose graph constants diverge, genuinely changed domains or representations, fourth-chaos or field-strength counterterms, and non-form strong-resolvent constructions remain outside the theorem
